title: Genesis 6:6–8 — God is sorry, mercy and judgment, Noah finds favor
summary: Genesis 6:6-8 in English: the LORD is sorry He made man and says He will blot man out, and then Noah finds favor in the LORD's eyes. Beneath verse 7 the multicoloured word God sits between “↓ Mercy ↓” and “↑ Judgment ↑”; the letters of LORD are in different colours.

text.text: 6 The LORD was sorry that He had made man on the earth, and He was grieved in His heart
7 The LORD said, “I will blot out man whom I have created from the face of the land, from man to animals to creeping things and to birds of the sky; for I am sorry that I have made them.”
8 And Noah found favor in the eyes of the LORD.
